title: StudioImportResult
description: The answer to the import route (2.18.0, AGB-1035): 201 when imported (`replaced: true` when it replaced other imported text of a version in review), 200 `{imported: false, noop: true}` when the same file was imported already. The run is an ordinary `run`: kind `edit`, executor `external`, `inputRef.source` `import`.

blocks.description: Number of blocks imported (absent on a noop).
